prefer_note: IRTF's scan with the PK50 blocker ({file}) is served: IRTF uses this filter with the uncoated PK50 blocker to suppress long-wavelength red leaks and publishes both scans.
cut_note: Cut at {max_um:g} um, the end of the 1-6 micron range over which IRTF states the NSFCam detector is sensitive ({n} samples beyond it removed).

incomplete.J: Incomplete: IRTF's J scans start at 1.282 um, inside the band, which begins near 1.10 um; no IRTF file covers its blue half.
